name: Classic One-Pager
description: One to three pages of numbered, stacked sections. Page 1 opens with the light-blue hero band (pill label, two-tone headline, subtitle, intro); later pages get a slim running header. Sections can hold body copy, bullets and striped label/value rows. Every page has the brand footer (logo, website / phone, social icons, page number); an optional call to action closes the last page.
bestFor: Narrative overviews and step-by-step material: product or feature overviews, announcements, onboarding journeys and how-to guides read top to bottom. Grows to extra pages instead of cutting important content.
guidance: Headline: title + title_accent read as one headline; put the 1-3 word payoff in title_accent (shown in blue), as in the Figma house style.
Use as few pages as the content honestly needs. Add a page rather than cutting facts a reader would miss, but never pad.
Every page except the last should be nearly full; the last page at least half full (render reports free space at the bottom per page).
Title: 4-9 words, outcome-led. Subtitle: one sentence, at most 20 words. Intro: 2-3 sentences, at most 55 words.

Sections are numbered automatically across pages. Heading 2-6 words; body at most 50 words; 0-5 bullets of at most 14 words; rows (label/value) 0-6, label at most 5 words, value at most 16 words. Use rows for stages, steps, limits and settings.
Page 1 fits about 3-4 sections after the hero; later pages about 4-6. A section never continues across pages, so move a whole section to the next page instead.
CTA: for sales material, a demo or contact CTA. For customer guides, point to help or support from the source, or leave headline empty to hide it.

eyebrow.description: Short uppercase label above the title, e.g. the product or audience. 1-4 words, or empty.

title_accent.description: Last 1-3 words of the headline, shown in Salesmsg Blue, or empty.

subtitle.description: Supporting line under the title, at most 20 words.

intro.description: 2-3 sentence opening paragraph, at most 55 words.

pages.description: 1-3 pages in reading order; each page is one printed sheet.

sections.description: 3-6 numbered sections on this page (page 1 has less room because of the hero).

rows.description: 0-6 label/value rows shown as a striped table.

headline.description: At most 8 words, or empty to hide the CTA.

url.description: Link from the source document, or the brand website.

cta.description: Closes the last page. Empty headline hides it.
